description: Use this when a Fantasy Premier League (FPL, fantasy football) manager wants their team rated, reviewed or checked, or shares their team ID or FPL link. Scores the squad 0-100 against the best possible squad over the next 5 gameweeks with the biggest fixes. Call it at once, even without their team: the answer then shows a card to find it by name. Takes a team ID, link or screenshot names.

players.description: 11-15 FPL player names (e.g. read from a screenshot of their team), used when there is no team ID. Add the club to disambiguate, e.g. 'Palmer CHE'.
players.title: Players

team_id.description: The manager's FPL team ID (entry ID), or any FPL link containing /entry/<id>/. Leave empty if unknown: the answer's card then finds their team with them.
team_id.title: Team Id

name: rate_my_team
title: Rate my team
